release.content: pubkit 0.14.1 was released on 2026-10-26 from commit c373c1d9b139aa87a0a230c4934f1426597b9085 with these changes.

rows: terraform/hosting names a Pages site's CNAME target at plan time, <project>.pages.dev or the site's new optional subdomain in pubkit.json, so the first apply that creates the Pages project no longer fails at deSEC with "Provider produced inconsistent final plan". Apply stops with the subdomain to set if Cloudflare gave the project another pages.dev name

pubkit protect can leave out the release tag ruleset for a repository that releases no tags: "tags": false in its protected.json entry, or --no-tags. When GitHub refuses one ruleset, the other's result is still printed

release.scope: the published release v0.14.1 of pubkit
